shop.name: Urban Thread
shop.description: Women's cotton kurtis and basics from Pune. Ready stock, shipped across India.
shop.tone: Friendly and short. Uses 'ji' when replying in Hindi or Hinglish. At most one emoji.

policies.title: Delivery time
policies.body: Pune: 1 to 2 days. Rest of India: 4 to 6 days.

policies.title: Delivery charge
policies.body: ₹60 for orders below ₹1,000. Free for orders of ₹1,000 and above.

policies.title: Size exchange
policies.body: Size exchange within 7 days of delivery if the item is unworn and tags are intact. No returns or refunds on sale items.

policies.title: Payment options
policies.body: UPI or bank transfer. Cash on delivery is available only in Pune.

sample_replies.customer_message: What colours does the palazzo come in?
sample_replies.reply: Hi! The Palazzo Pants come in Black and White, in one free size that fits waists from 28 to 38 inches. Only a few pieces are left, so do let me know soon 😊
Ji, Palazzo free size hai, kamar 28 se 38 inch tak fit hoti hai.

sample_replies.customer_message: क्या पलाज़ो सफेद रंग में मिलेगा?
sample_replies.reply: जी, पलाज़ो पैंट काले और सफेद रंग में मिलती है। फ्री साइज़ है, कमर 28 से 38 इंच तक फिट होती है।
आमची चॅट वेळ रोज सकाळी १० ते रात्री ८ आहे.
